subject: Delegate access request and audit period boundary clarification
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@brightshore-audit.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: delegated reviewer access + audit period confirmation

Hi Priyom / Kimberly,

Quick question ahead of our fieldwork kickoff: Brightshore is bringing an external reviewer (Sally Turner from ACME Compliance) to assist on evidence collection for your SOC 2 Type II. Sally will act as our delegated reviewer under Brightshore's engagement. Can Redwood provision a short-lived delegated access for Sally (view + approved-download) via the trust portal rather than sharing evidence by SFTP?

Also: please confirm Redwood's SOC 2 report audit period you have on file. Our planning docs show 2027-07-01 through 2028-06-30, but we want to be certain of the boundary for requested artifacts. If evidence outside that window is required, we may need a bridge letter.

Requested artifacts (high level): access logs, SOC 2 report bundle, change-control evidence for releases between May–Jun 2028.

Attachment: brightshore_requester_sheet.xlsx (list of requested evidence types)

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Senior Manager, Brightshore Audit
emily.zhang@brightshore-audit.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@brightshore-audit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Jul 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delegated reviewer access + audit period confirmation

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up.

Couple quick items so we can provision cleanly:
- Can you confirm Sally's legal name and email for the portal invite?
- We typically provision either (A) auditor-only access (auditor creates reviewer accounts) or (B) a one-time delegated reviewer link generated by Redwood that we rotate after the window. We prefer option B for short external consultants.
- For downloads: we allow approved artifacts to be downloaded during the timebox, and we export access logs and IPs afterward.

If you confirm Sally's details I’ll coordinate with Kimberly to schedule a 2–4 hour window for the delegation. Also please confirm the exact audit period you want us to treat as the boundary (your note about 2027-07-01 — 2028-06-30 matches our records but I want explicit confirmation).

I’ve looped in Kimberly (security/compliance) to approve scope and any extra controls (IP allowlist, MFA).

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Director, Trust & Compliance | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@brightshore-audit.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 Jul 2028 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delegated reviewer access + audit period confirmation

Hi all — thanks Emily. A few security notes and process items from Redwood: 

1) Delegation model: our standard policy does not allow adding third-party consultants as independent portal users unless the auditor accepts responsibility for that user and signs our delegation addendum. If Brightshore will accept responsibility for Sally, we can provision a delegated reviewer account that the auditor manages for the session.

2) Required controls for delegated reviewers: signed confidentiality acknowledgement (DocuSign), timebox (max 4 hours), IP allowlist (if you can provide IPs), and download scoping to specific evidence bundles only.

3) Audit period: Redwood's SOC 2 Type II covers 2027-07-01 through 2028-06-30. If Brightshore needs evidence after 2028-06-30 (e.g., July 2028 items), we can produce a bridge letter that affirms no control changes material to the scope between the report end and your requested evidence window, or provide supplemental artifacts on a best-effort basis. Please indicate whether a bridge letter is required.

I’ve attached our delegation template for your counsel to expedite the acceptance.

Attachment: delegation_template.docx

Kimberly Park
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.com

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@brightshore-audit.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 Jul 2028 07:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: delegated reviewer access + audit period confirmation

Thanks Kimberly — Brightshore will accept responsibility for Sally as our delegated reviewer and will sign Redwood's delegation addendum. 

Sally's details: Sally Turner <sally.turner@acmeconsult.com>
Requested window: Aug 2, 2028 09:00–13:00 UTC (4 hours) — the team prefers an early UTC window to overlap with our US/EU reviewers.

We also request a temporary SSO jumpbox link (one-time session) to avoid giving persistent credentials. For downloads: we need access to the S3 evidence slice for the specified artifacts; if Redwood can scope a single zip with those files available during the window that would be ideal.

Attached the Brightshore requester sheet for the artifact mapping. Kickoff is scheduled Aug 5, so if we can lock access this week that helps.

Attachment: brightshore_requester_sheet.xlsx

Emily

Emily — thanks, we’ll proceed on this plan. Summary and next steps: 

- Delegation: Brightshore will sign the addendum via DocuSign. I’m sending the DocuSign link now.
- One-time SSO: created and valid for Aug 2, 09:00–13:00 UTC. Link: https://trust-portal.redwood.com/session/one-time/abc123 (will be rotated/disabled at 13:05 UTC)
- Download bundle: we will stage a single evidence zip scoped to the requested artifacts and allow download only during the timebox.
- Audit period: confirmed — SOC 2 Type II covers 2027-07-01 through 2028-06-30. If you require artifacts outside that range, please confirm whether you need a bridge letter; we can provide one.
- Logging: we will export session logs (user, IP, files downloaded) and deliver to Brightshore within 24 hours of session close.

DocuSign (confidentiality / delegation addendum): https://docusign.com/link/ZZY-72-req
HubSpot ticket for tracking: https://hubspot.com/contacts/HS-9921

Attachment: confidentiality_ack.pdf (executed stub will be returned once DocuSign completes)

If all good, Emily please confirm and we’ll finalize the DocuSign so Kimberly can trigger the invite.

Best,
Priyom
